parsing.notes: reCAPTCHA + paid. Official Registre Central du Commerce (OMPIC). directinfo.ma free basic search is Google reCAPTCHA-gated; detailed company data, Bilans (financial statements), statistics, and the OMPIC API (CAPI) are paid/subscription. No open bulk. Do NOT bypass reCAPTCHA/paywall. Prefer the official subscription API once licensed. Field model from public knowledge; no values copied. ICE (15-digit) = unified company id; RC (per court) + IF (tax). Redact dirigeants/associés (Law 09-08).

mapping_rules.company_id: ICE (15-digit unified id) or RC number.
mapping_rules.vat_id: none separate (TVA tied to the IF).

live_test_plan.smoke: Not runnable headless (reCAPTCHA/paid). Review the OMPIC API doc (CAPI) before any implementation.
live_test_plan.full: Blocked on payment — use the OMPIC subscription API under licence; redact personal data.
